annotations.title: Generate FAR Part 43 REA, Constructive Change & Eichleay CDA Claim Package

description: Analyze post-award scope creep, out-of-scope COR technical directions, Government-Furnished Equipment/Information (GFE/GFI) or ATO delays, and stop-work orders under FAR 52.243-1/2/3/4, FAR 52.242-14/15/17, and the Contract Disputes Act (41 U.S.C. 7101) to generate a Request for Equitable Adjustment (REA) or Certified CDA Claim package containing a 5-element constructive change proof, a DCAA-auditable Quantum Cost Schedule (direct labor, indirect burden, Eichleay unabsorbed home office overhead, FAR 31.205-33 allowable REA preparation costs, and DFARS 215.404-71 weighted guidelines profit), an Eichleay 3-step standby overhead and CPM schedule extension analysis, and verbatim DFARS 252.243-7002 and CDA 41 U.S.C. 7103 certifications. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive post-award contract claims and quantum analysis generator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `contract_change_and_delay_facts` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters, while `remedy_clause_and_submission_type` and `quantum_pricing_methodology` calibrate non-adversarial FAR Part 43 REAs vs. interest-bearing CDA claims). Use this tool when quantifying post-award constructive changes, Government delays, or Eichleay standby overhead for a Contracting Officer REA or CDA claim; use `analyze_debriefing_bid_protest` instead for pre-award or post-award GAO/COFC bid protests under FAR 15.506, or `generate_post_award_cpar_rebuttal` for FAR 42.1503 CPARS rating rebuttals.

contract_change_and_delay_facts.description: Chronology of out-of-scope COR/CO technical directions, Government-furnished equipment/information (GFE/GFI) or ATO delays, stop-work orders, standby labor costs, and company overhead figures (20 to 45,000 characters).

quantum_pricing_methodology.description: Quantum pricing method (Segregated Actual Costs, Modified Total Cost, Jury Verdict Method, Eichleay Unabsorbed Home Office Overhead, and FAR 31.205-33 REA Preparation Cost recovery; defaults to 'Segregated_Actual_Labor_Hours_Plus_Eichleay_Standby_Overhead_And_FAR_31_205_33_Prep_Costs').

remedy_clause_and_submission_type.description: Target remedy clause and submission posture (e.g., Non-Adversarial FAR Part 43 REA under FAR 52.243-1/2/3/4 & DFARS 252.243-7002 vs. Certified CDA Claim under 41 U.S.C. 7103; defaults to 'FAR_52_243_1_Constructive_Change_And_FAR_52_242_17_Delay_Non_Adversarial_REA').

name: generate_rea_equitable_adjustment

eichleay_and_delay_schedule_analysis.description: Eichleay 3-step unabsorbed home office overhead calculation and Critical Path Method (CPM) schedule extension justification.

rea_entitlement_executive_overview.description: High-level REA vs. CDA legal posture, 5-element constructive change proof, and total recommended adjustment.

rea_quantum_cost_schedule.description: DCAA-auditable Quantum Cost Breakdown across direct labor, indirect pools, Eichleay standby overhead, REA preparation costs (FAR 31.205-33), and weighted guidelines profit.

statutory_certification_and_notice_block.description: Verbatim DFARS 252.243-7002 REA and CDA 41 U.S.C. 7103 certifications, timely notice defense, and SF-30 reservation-of-rights language.

title: Generate FAR Part 43 REA, Constructive Change & Eichleay CDA Claim Package
